title: Pure Magistus
summary: The pure Magistus build with generic staples. The Magistus Spellcasters equip Extra Deck Magistus monsters to themselves to gain search, revival, and disruption effects while setting up Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Spenta, the Magistus Sealer discards itself to search any Magistus monster, and banishes itself from the GY to equip a Magistus from the Extra Deck or GY.
Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame equips a Magistus from the Extra Deck and revives a Level 4 Spellcaster in Defense Position.
Rilliona, the Magistus of Verre searches a Magistus Spell or Trap on summon, while Crowley, the Gifted Magistus Special Summons itself when added to the hand.

summary.title: Opening: Spenta into Calamity & Omega
steps: Discard Spenta, the Magistus Sealer to search Crowley, the Gifted Magistus, which Special Summons itself when added to your hand.
Normal Summon Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame, equip Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden from the Extra Deck, and use Artemis to search another Magistus monster while Zoroa revives a Level 4 Spellcaster.
Synchro Summon Zoroa, the Magistus Conflagrant Calamity using Zoroa and a Level 4 Spellcaster, equipping an Extra Deck Magistus to lock the opponent out of that Extra Deck card type.
Use Crowley, the Gifted Magistus (which counts as Aleister the Invoker) to Fusion Summon Invoked Magistus Omega or Zoroa, the Magistus Verethragna.

summary.title: Equipping the Extra Deck
summary.text: Every Extra Deck Magistus grants an effect while equipped to a monster: Artemis searches a Magistus monster, Rilliona, the Wondrous Magistus Witch Wardrobe negates a face-up monster effect, Ninaruru, the Magistus Glass Goddess destroys a Spell or Trap, and Vahram, the Magistus Divinity Dragon destroys any monster the equipped monster battles. Endymion, the Magistus of Mastery and Crowley, the Magistus of Grimoires attach additional Extra Deck pieces and trade face-up Spells for draws.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Zoroa, the Magistus Conflagrant Calamity equips a Magistus from the Extra Deck or GY on Synchro Summon and prevents the opponent from activating effects of monsters that share a card type (Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link) with your equipped Magistus cards.
Invoked Magistus Omega banishes an opponent's monster alongside one from your GY, while Zoroa, the Magistus Verethragna equips an opposing Effect Monster and negates monster effects.
Aiwass, the Magistus Spell Spirit equips itself to an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect to take control of it, and Magistus Chorozo stops attacks.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Verre Magic - Lacrima of Light and Magia Magic - Thunder of Judgment count as Magistus cards: Lacrima sends a Spellcaster or Spell to the GY or summons a Magistus from the Deck, while Thunder of Judgment sends a Magistus card to summon a Spellcaster or banish a card.
Magistus Invocation Fusion Summons using equipped Magistus cards as material, while Magistus Theurgy equips from the Extra Deck, GY, or field at Quick-Play speed.
Magistus Vritra revives a Level 4 Magistus, and Trismagistus deploys Level 4 Spellcasters from the hand while protecting equipped Magistus in battle.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's hybrid combo lines add Fairy Tail, Endymion, Witchcrafter, and Dracotail packages, which are omitted here to keep the build pure Magistus.
